summary: A 2022 relaunch page on the newer Grilli Type template (Tailwind, sticky full-width sections that stack over each other in red, white and black): 'GT Pressura Refreshed' hero with clickable style lists, live metric boxes showing Mono vs Standard vs Extended widths, invented Constructivist/industrial artefacts per subfamily, Lottie animations of ink pressure, script specimen cards and CJK matching, an animated glyph inspector, and a full-screen auto-fit type tester opened from a fixed top bar.

instances.look: Signal-red field: hairline, then 'GT Pressura' in black and 'Refreshed' in white (~140px Bold), then a 7-line intro at ~45px
instances.ux: Fixed 62px top bar ('GT PRESSURA' left, outlined 'TYPETESTER' and 'PURCHASE' buttons right) over every section; the red section is sticky and the next white section slides over it
instances.learn: Announce the update in the headline itself ('Refreshed', in a second colour): a relaunch page needs the news before the name

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed red section, content column x≈225–1215 (990px, 12-col grid); hairline at y≈50, heading at y≈160 (two lines), intro paragraph 0.5 column wide (~810px) below; section sticky with negative --sticky-top so it stays while the next card covers it
reconstruction.typography: Heading ~140px GT Pressura Proportional Bold (wdth 100), line 2 white; intro ~45px GT Pressura Extended Medium (wdth 150, wght 500), leading 1.1–1.2; nav ~12px GT Pressura Mono caps
reconstruction.behaviour: Black loader with a Lottie of a red stamp being pressed ('LOADING DATA. PLEASE WAIT. THANK YOU.', ~3s); sticky stacking of sections on scroll
reconstruction.content: Real positioning copy: 'uses the visual gesture of ink spreading under pressure as a stylistic device… now with extended weights and a refreshed design'

instances.look: 'Mono', 'Standard', 'Extended' set huge with every letter in a ruled box, an x-height line across, and each box labelled with its advance width ('←550→', '←394→', '←635→')
instances.ux: The weight animates 300↔900 while boxes resize and the width readouts count live; Mono boxes stay at 550, Standard and Extended grow; the x-height rule slides slightly (39.1% → 37.7%)
instances.learn: Box each letter and print its advance width as it animates: the difference between monospaced and proportional becomes a number you can watch
